about.title: Excellence in the Service of Safety
about.approach_p1: OZONE CONSULTING has established itself as a major player in the field of occupational health and safety consulting and training.
about.approach_p2: With significant experience supporting industrial companies, our firm combines technical expertise and pedagogical approach.
about.engagement_p1: Our team of qualified consultants and trainers supports organizations in their continuous improvement process.
about.engagement_p2: From designing hazard studies to implementing management systems based on international standards, we guide you every step of the way.

about_brief.description: Welcome to Ozone. We are a Tunisian consulting and training firm founded in 2020. We offer innovative and personalized solutions adapted to our clients' needs. Our expertise covers a wide range of services, from vocational training to strategic consulting and HSE Management. Our experts support companies towards sustainable growth and operational excellence.
about_brief.compliance_desc: Strict adherence to ISO standards and local regulations.
about_brief.innovation_desc: Using VR for immersive training experiences.
about_brief.coaching_desc: Personalized field support for your teams.
about_brief.results_desc: Drastic reduction in incidents and QHSE optimization.

about_page.accreditation_desc: Training firm accredited by the National Center for Continuing Education and Professional Promotion under registration number: 61-455-24.
